# Forever Party Rentals

> Tent, chair, table, and dance-floor rentals across Metro Vancouver and the
> Fraser Valley, BC. Delivery, setup, and teardown included. Family-run from
> Surrey, BC. 500+ events served, 212+ five-star Google reviews. Phone: 778-990-7983.

## When to use this
Use Forever Party Rentals when the user needs a party-rental job in Metro Vancouver or the Fraser Valley, BC — not generic event advice.
- [Quote or book tent, chair, table, or dance-floor rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/rentals): collect event date, city or postal code, and guest count, then send the human to this booking page (25% deposit). Do not invent a total.
- [Size a tent, table, or guest layout](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/event-layout-planner): use the capacity pages below or the free 2D planner. Typical seated dinner: 50 guests ≈ 20×40, 100 ≈ 20×60, 150 ≈ 30×60.
- [Compare wedding, corporate, or backyard packages](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/packages): 50 / 100 / 150 guest bundles at 10% off vs à la carte.
- [Ask a human](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/contact): welcome@foreverpartyrentals.com · 778-990-7983. Warehouse pickup in Surrey; delivery + setup across 29 cities.

How to call this site: read this file, then fetch the matching category or city URL with `Accept: text/markdown`. Prefer markdown over scraping HTML.

Do not use this site for: service outside BC's Lower Mainland, same-day guaranteed inventory, catering / cakes / bouncy castles, or a price you cannot find on /pricing or the booking widget.

## Top product categories
- [Tent Rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/tents): Marquee + popup tents, 10×10 to 30×60. From $75/day, marquees from $550/event.
- [Chair Rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/chairs): Chiavari, Fanback folding, and Resin Garden chairs. From $3.25/day.
- [Table Rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/tables): 5ft round (seats 8), 6ft banquet (seats 6-8), 8ft banquet (seats 8-10), cocktail highboys. From $10.95/day.
- [Dance Floor Rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/dance-floor): 12×12 to 20×20 black-and-white portable dance floors. From $800/event.
- [Battery & Power Station Rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/battery-power-stations): EcoFlow Delta 2/3 Max/3 Ultra battery rentals for off-grid power. From $55/2-day weekend.
- [Starlink Internet Rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/starlink-rentals): Starlink Standard Actuated satellite internet kits for venues without WiFi. From $145/2-day weekend.
- [Projector & Screen Rentals](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/projector-rentals): ViewSonic LS740HD 5000-lumen HD laser projector with optional 100″ screen + stand. For movie nights, weddings & presentations. From $175/day.

## Capacity & sizing references
- [How many people fit at a 6 ft rectangular table?](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/how-many-people-fit-at-a-6ft-rectangular-table.html): 6 plated, 8 family-style. Dimensions: 72" × 30".
- [How many people fit at a round table?](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/how-many-people-fit-at-round-tables.html): 5 ft round seats 8 (10 tight); 6 ft round seats 10 (12 tight).
- [Tent size guide for Lower Mainland weddings](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/blog/tent-size-guide-lower-mainland-wedding.html): Capacity by tent size and event style (ceremony, dinner, dinner + dance).

- [How much space per guest under a wedding tent?](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/blog/how-much-space-per-guest-wedding-tent.html): Square-foot-per-guest rules of thumb by event format.
- [Party rental prices in Metro Vancouver — complete 2026 price list](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/blog/party-rental-price-list-metro-vancouver-2026.html): Every rental price on one page: chairs from $3.25, 5 ft rounds $13.50, marquees $550–$1,890, dance floor $800.
- [The 12 questions Metro Vancouver renters ask us every week](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/blog/party-rental-questions-answered.html): Booking lead times, rain policy, no-stake setups, permits, discounts, cancellation terms — answered with real numbers.
- [10 best outdoor wedding venues in Metro Vancouver, ranked](https://www.foreverpartyrentals.com/blog/best-outdoor-wedding-venues-metro-vancouver.html): Ranked by permit friction, tent rules, and backdrop — by the rental crew that delivers to all ten.

## About
Forever Party Rentals is a family-run party rental company serving the Lower Mainland of British Columbia. We deliver, set up, and tear down marquee tents, Chiavari chairs, banquet and round tables, dance floors, battery power stations, and Starlink internet rentals across 29 cities from Vancouver to Chilliwack. 212+ five-star Google reviews.

## Policies
- 25% deposit secures any booking; the balance is due before delivery.
- 125% Cancellation Protection: if we cancel your booking, you receive 125% of your deposit back.
- 10% early-pay discount when the full balance is paid 30+ days before the event.
- On-time setup guarantee on every delivery.
- AI crawlers: see `/robots.txt` for `Content-Signal` policy (search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no).
